import java.util.Scanner;

import java.util.Scanner;


public class Last {

	/**
	 * @param args
	 */
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = input.nextInt();
		int[]x = new int[n];
		int r = 1;
		for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
			x[i] = input.nextInt();
			if(i > 0){
			if(x[i] != x[i-1]){
				r++;
			}
			}
		}
		System.out.println(r);
		
	}

	}
